`expansion-shell.rbf.gz` is an 8.6 KiB gzip container (mtime zero) for the
synthetic SX120F shell generated in `misteross/expansion/rbf_test.go:fixtures`.
It is not a deployable FPGA design. Its decompressed SHA256 is
`f38894e270e9e2771e157ebdf8767e92ad58d63de0764e7b03afdef0842ec5a0`.
The same bytes were independently generated by `scripts/cyclonev_rbf.py`:
ORAM/PRAM header byte i is `(i * 17) & 255`; all CRAM bits start zero, then
(100,64), (2000,100), and (3500,80) are set. Save compressed using SX120F.

This compact retained fixture makes FogCast's full composition staging,
adoption and cleanup test run in ordinary CI without an FPGA build. The
standalone Go linker's golden test checks the same decompressed hash and
performs the cart overlay equivalence comparison against Python.
